:::{#def-lasso}
#### LASSO estimate

The **LASSO** (Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator) estimate
of the coefficients $\vb = \tp{(\beta_1, \dots, \beta_p)}$
maximizes the [log-likelihood](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-loglik)
minus an $\lpnorm{1}$ penalty:

$$
\est{\vb}_\lambda \eqdef \arg\max_{\vb} \set{
\llik(\vb) - \lambda \sum_{j=1}^p \abs{\beta_j}
}
$$ {#eq-lasso}

where $\lambda \ge 0$ is a
[tuning parameter](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/model-validation.html#def-tuning-parameter).
The intercept, if any, is not penalized.

:::
